source_file: fireballs.html, "FIREBALLS — Straight-flight FX Lab" (owner-supplied as /Users/bri/Downloads/fireballs.html, kept local, not distributed)
effect: 01 / FIREBALLS (mode 'fireballs'): FireballsFX fireball, trail and impact
target: Quake's flying lava balls, progs/lavaball.mdl (misc_fireball lava spurts; Chthon's thrown balls, boss.qc boss_missile)
extraction: No asset files: the source is procedural. GLSL and constants copied into r_lavaballs.js; nothing is decoded or stored here.

FIREBALL_FRAGMENT.use: every statement of main(); the output is kept as `src` and written premultiplied times LAVABALL.gain

PARTICLE_FRAGMENT.use: every statement of main() but gl_PointCoord (a quad's coordinate, y down as gl_PointCoord) and the output

PARTICLE_VERTEX.use: the point size rule (aSize world units, clamped 1..180 px) as a camera-facing quad

FxParticles.use: fixed-size pools, oldest slot recycled; emit/update rules (drag, gravity, grow, life) as typed arrays; the lab's floor bounce is not taken

_spawn.use: three PlaneGeometry(3.6, 1.8) translated -1.65 along the flight, turned i*60 degrees, uPhase i*5.1, additive

_impact.use: max(3, floor(65*density*size)) sparks, ring(0.35 s, 1.6*size), ceil(12*size) smoke puffs, with the source's speeds, colours, sizes, lives, gravity and drag; normal = against the direction of travel (the source's fallback)

_updateFireballs.use: grow-in min(1, 0.3+age*9); 480*density*size trail particles per second up to 2.6*size behind, 23% sparks, with the source's colours, sizes, lives, gravity and drift

burstPlan / fireballsPlan / straightPoin.why: the four-lane volley and its straight-line planner: Quake decides how many balls fly and where; each native ball draws one fireball along its own motion

PointLight.why: the native ball keeps its own dynamic light (EF_ROCKET, cl_main.js)

_spawn launch ring.why: the client cannot tell a ball being thrown from one coming into view; a ring popping in mid-air would be wrong

scale: Quake units per source unit = r_fireball.js FIREBALL.unit (24); the source's flight (about 12.6 source units/s) is then Chthon's 300 units/s
